The readings were recorded from 2025-10-06 00:00:00 to 2025-10-16 23:00:00, and the recording frequency is hour (H). Initially, the owner started rennovation from 2025-10-14 07:00:00 to 2025-10-14 08:00:00 and did not stay at the unit, leading to low power usage of the first 201 readings. After the rennovation finished on 2025-10-14 09:00:00, the house is fully occupied, leading to a permanent increase in electricty usage.

TECHNICAL OPERATIONAL REPORT
Date: December 21, 2024
Subject: Hawthorn Estate 2024 Utility Audit and Energy Baseline Report

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
This report, prepared by the Facilities Oversight Department, provides a comprehensive audit of electricity consumption for the Hawthorn Estate throughout the 2024 calendar year. The primary objective of this audit is to document the impact of the scheduled renovation period on utility baselines and to confirm the residential occupancy status during the project lifecycle. 

2. OCCUPANCY STATUS AND PROJECT TIMELINE
The Stewardship Management Group officially confirms that the Hawthorn Estate was completely empty for the duration of the 2024 renovation project. This vacancy was a necessary operational requirement to facilitate the scope of work. All residential activities were suspended, and no staff or occupants resided on the premises while the renovation was underway. 

3. HISTORICAL ELECTRICITY USAGE ANALYSIS
Based on historical electricity usage records maintained by this department, the Hawthorn Estate typically operates within a established monthly consumption baseline. However, documentation of the 2024 renovation period shows a significant deviation from these historical norms.

During the active phase of the renovation project, internal monitoring and utility billing data reflect a marked decrease in electric usage. This reduction is directly attributable to the absence of residential occupants and the deactivation of non-essential appliances and environmental control systems. The data confirms that throughout the renovation period, electric consumption remained consistently below the standard operational threshold.

4. POST-RENOVATION BASELINE REVERSION
Following the conclusion of the onsite work and the transition out of the renovation phase, facilities data indicates that electric usage has reverted to the normal baseline. This stabilization occurred immediately following the re-occupancy preparation phase. 

Official monitoring confirms that the renovation project, the temporary reduction in energy demand, and the subsequent return to baseline usage levels were all finalized before the end of the 2024 calendar year. As of the date of this report, the estate’s utility profile has returned to its pre-renovation status, and all project-related fluctuations have concluded prior to the start of 2025.

Each subsequent twenty-four-hour cycle is anticipated to surpass the maximum demand recorded in the preceding day. System operators should prepare for these escalating peak levels as the estate continues its current trend of consumption growth.

SUBJECT: Project Completion and Logistics Update: Residential Renovation

As we approach the final transition phase of the residential renovation project, this memo serves to document the aesthetic specifications and provide a final update on the logistics regarding furniture delivery and site assembly.

Aesthetic Choices and Design Philosophy
The renovation was centered on a "Modern Transitional" aesthetic, aiming to balance contemporary cleanliness with classic residential warmth. This was achieved by utilizing high-contrast textures—pairing matte-finished surfaces with polished stone—to create a sophisticated yet inviting environment.
